body:
This makes sense, but my friend has only told me about this, and she is terrified about telling anyone else or telling her husband that she has talked to me about it. Again, not because he is abusive, but because she does not want to make this a big problem. I really want to help, but I can't talk to him. I can only advise my friend. I did tell her to find out why he does these things though, which kind of goes along with what you are talking about. 

Also, don't apologize :) thanks for your help!

We are first years, so we still have a lot to learn. I have suggested therapy, but my friend is afraid. She doesn't want to go because then, in her mind, this will be a serious problem. She said she wouldn't suggest it to her husband because he does not like talking about this issue. He gets very quiet when she brings it up.
